Private Function Fetch(ByVal target As Object, ByVal name As String) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If IsObject(CallByName(target, name, VbGet)) Then
        Fetch = TypeName(CallByName(target, name, VbGet))
    Else
        v = CallByName(target, name, VbGet)
        If IsArray(v) Then Fetch = "Array" Else Fetch = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Fetch = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String

    Dim at As Object, le As Object, sr As Object, sh As Object, sr2 As Object, tf As Object, s As String

    Dim g As Object, bt As Object, cb As Object
    Set g = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeOval, 10, 320, 40, 40).Name, ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeOval, 60, 320, 40, 40).Name)).Group
    Set bt = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(xlButtonControl, 120, 320, 60, 20)
    Set cb = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(xlCheckBox, 200, 320, 60, 20)
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(g, "Child")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(g.GroupItems(1), "Child")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(g.GroupItems(1), "Connector")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(g, "FormControlType")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(bt, "FormControlType")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(cb, "FormControlType")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(bt, "HasSmartArt")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(bt, "BlackWhiteMode")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(g.Name)), "Child")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(g.Name)), "GroupItems")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(sh.Name, g.Name)), "ID")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(sh.Name, g.Name)), "HasChart")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(sh.Name, g.Name)), "ZOrderPosition")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(sh.Name, g.Name)), "Parent")
    s = s & "@@@" & Fetch(ws.Shapes.Range(Array(co.Name)), "HasChart")
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
